results.title: Fleet Manager

We foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment built on mutual respect, innovation, and a healthy work-life balance. With a strong track record in recruitment, managed services, and workforce solutions, we take pride in being a trusted long-term partner in driving success for both our clients and our people. ABOUT THE ROLE A Fleet Manager is required to lead the daily operations of the delivery fleet, ensuring riders are effectively managed, operational issues are resolved promptly, and delivery performance consistently meets business targets. The role works closely with operations and maintenance teams to optimize rider performance and ensure compliance with company policies and UAE regulations. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Supervise and manage the daily activities of delivery riders. Plan rider shifts, attendance, and manpower allocation to support operational requirements. Monitor rider performance, productivity, and punctuality, implementing corrective actions where necessary. Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced operational environment. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Good communication skills and a solid understanding of UAE regulations.

results.title: Product Operations Manager
results.description: Murphy AI deploys voice AI agents that help banks collect debt. We’ve built a fully-fledged platform designed to optimize recovery rates while maintaining respectful and personalized communication. Our advanced automation streamlines the process of collecting overdue invoices for banks and other industries, providing a seamless and effective solution . Our AI-powered agents adapt instantly, engaging with debtors across channels like voice, messengers, email and sms to maximize results while preserving trust. By combining advanced artificial intelligence with powerful automation, we’re setting a new standard for how businesses recover payments . As a fast-growing startup that has already made an impact within less than a year in the market, we are building a talented team to scale our operations and drive our vision forward 🌟 About The Role We're looking for a Product Operations Manager to scale Murphy. We need someone to deploy into new territory, impose order on chaos, and stand up the operation — then do it again in the next market. You'll own the expansion playbook, partners and vendors, product quality and enable x1,000 growth of the company that proved its product-market-fit. This is a founder's right hand on execution and operations, with outsized leverage over where the company goes. Murphy builds AI voice agents that collect overdue debt for banks: more recovered, faster, cheaper, fully compliant, and respectful to the debtor. We're live with Santander, Revolut, BBVA and dozens others. We've proven the product in large-scale pilots with top-tier banks — now we're taking it into every market and every adjacent business, and we need someone to own that expansion end to end. What you'll do Productise expansion. Turn a new country from a bespoke project into a repeatable playbook: localised voice, policies, compliance per market, so we go live in weeks, not quarters. Be the operating system of the product org. Own the planning cadence, the metrics and the prioritisation across bets, so a small team makes big, fast, well-sequenced calls. Dive deep and problem solve. Get to the roots of complex problems, understand all the nuances and design solutions that solve the root cause elegantly. Who you are A builder and an operator. You've converted uncertainty and chaos into a well-oiled execution machine — a process, a team, or a function — whether as a founder, an operations lead, a PM, or a military officer who's stood up and led an operation under pressure. You own outcomes, and you never settle. You hold people accountable and demand a high execution excellence bar under speed. You have a STEM degree, and you were top of your class. You're technical, rigorous with numbers, and have a strong philosophy of a champion. AI-native, ruthless on quality. You reach for AI to automate and streamline by default — and you know exactly where it gets sloppy. You never let that through, and you control quality rigorously. You don't need a collections or fintech background. We'd rather teach the domain to a killer than hire a lifer who can't ship — you'll pick up regulation, unit economics and a new market cold, fast. 🤝 What we offer 💰 Salary at the top of the benchmark. 📈 Fair equity with enormous upside potential. 🧩 Real Ownership - Murphy's strategy is yours to drive. 🙌 Small team, high autonomy, and outsized impact. 🗣️ The founding team's direct attention, and a category with a $300B+ industry behind it. 🛜 Hybrid & Flexible : Our default setup is hybrid – 3 days a week at our office, and 2 days of remote work. 📚 Our Process 1️⃣ First Interview – Getting to Know You A conversation with a future teammate who’s excited to find a new colleague. We’ll talk about your story, what drives you, and what you’re looking for next—no trick questions, just a genuine exchange. 2️⃣ Second Interview – Deep Dive You’ll meet the Hiring Manager and potentially another team member. This is a more technical discussion where we explore your skills in detail, walk through real scenarios, and answer any questions you might have about the role. 3️⃣ Tech Assessment or Business Case A practical exercise to see how you approach challenges similar to those you’d tackle at Murphy. You’ll have time to reflect and showcase your thinking—no rush, no surprises. 4️⃣ Call with the Founders Our founders meet every team member and it’s a great opportunity for you to learn about the company and its direction. 👉 To learn more about how we hire and what to expect at every step, feel free to explore our Hiring Guide! 👉 We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where everyone, regardless of background, identity, or experience, feels valued and empowered to thrive. We believe that different perspectives drive innovation and success, and we actively foster an environment where all voices are heard and respected.

results.description: Bitexen MENA is looking for an experienced Operations Manager to manage the day-to-day operations of its regulated centralized cryptocurrency exchange in Abu Dhabi. This is a hands-on management role requiring extensive experience in cryptocurrency exchange operations, direct use of exchange back-office platforms and a comprehensive understanding of how a centralized exchange operates across the full customer and transaction lifecycle. The successful candidate will coordinate and control operational processes across customer onboarding, account management, deposits and withdrawals, trading, treasury, customer support and compliance-related workflows. The role requires previous managerial responsibility within a cryptocurrency exchange and practical experience in an ADGM- or VARA-regulated environment. Key Responsibilities Ensure the platform operates smoothly and without disruption. Maintain strong oversight of trading operations, identify unusual or failed processes promptly, escalate issues to the relevant teams and coordinate their resolution through to completion. Manage end-to-end exchange operations, including customer onboarding, account management, deposits, withdrawals, trading and post-trade processes. Oversee the exchange back-office platform, operational approvals, transaction exceptions and issue resolution. Monitor pending, failed, rejected, frozen or incorrectly processed transactions and ensure timely investigation and resolution. Ensure customer, transaction and balance information is accurately reflected across the exchange, custody, compliance and other relevant systems. Coordinate with Compliance, MLRO, Treasury, Custody, Customer Support, Product and Technology teams to ensure seamless operational delivery. Ensure operational activities comply with ADGM or VARA requirements, internal policies, procedures and approved control frameworks. Maintain effective maker-checker controls, approval workflows, segregation of duties and access restrictions across operational processes. Manage operational incidents, assess customer and business impact, coordinate corrective actions and escalate material matters to the Chief Operations Officer. Develop and monitor operational KPIs, service levels, pending cases, incidents and control exceptions. Prepare regular operational reports and management information for the Chief Operations Officer and senior management. Review and improve operational procedures to enhance efficiency, scalability, control effectiveness and customer experience. Support product launches, platform developments, testing activities and operational readiness. Lead and supervise the operations team, allocate responsibilities, monitor performance and ensure consistent execution of daily activities. Qualifications Minimum 8 years of professional experience , including substantial hands-on experience within a centralized cryptocurrency exchange. Previous experience as an Operations Manager, Operations Supervisor, Head of Operations or in an equivalent managerial role within a cryptocurrency exchange is mandatory. Hands-on experience using a centralized cryptocurrency exchange back-office platform is mandatory. Strong practical understanding of customer onboarding, deposits and withdrawals, wallet operations, trading and post-trade processes, treasury coordination, customer support and compliance-related workflows. Previous experience within an ADGM- or VARA-regulated cryptocurrency business is mandatory. Demonstrable experience identifying and resolving platform, trading, transaction and customer-impacting operational issues. Experience managing operational incidents, transaction exceptions and cross-functional resolution processes. Strong understanding of operational controls, maker-checker processes, segregation of duties and approval structures. Proven team-management, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to manage multiple operational priorities and make timely decisions in a fast-paced and highly regulated environment. Professional proficiency in English. This role is not suitable for candidates whose experience is limited to traditional banking operations, general fintech operations, customer support or theoretical knowledge of cryptocurrency exchanges.

results.description: Description Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfill and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. It’s driven by Operations Managers who bring the team together to push excellence in safety, quality, and productivity across our sites. At your site, you’ll lead other managers and create the operational plan that helps your teams meet their targets. This role is all about driving operational excellence to create the Amazon of tomorrow. Key job responsibilities Manage and develop a team of Area Managers Lead operational teams on a shift, deal with issues, and positively impact site performance Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence Work closely with other support teams, including HR, Finance, Health and Safety, and Security Design and deliver initiatives across the sites to improve operational performance A day in the life You’ll lead shifts at one of our operational sites. You’ll also be the key link between a number of teams, including finance, safety, and operations integration teams. That means you’ll be close to the day-to-day operations at your site but also contribute to new ways to innovate at your site. A typical day will involve meetings with different areas of the business, deep diving into performance and risk metrics for sites, and looking ahead to prepare for different levels of demand. Every day will also involve mentoring and coaching your team. You’ll be a source of leadership and support for your team to be the best managers they can be. About The Team Customer Fulfillment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team, which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business, and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably. The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we’re known for. We’re based in Fulfillment Centers, which are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced Operations network. Our centers are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock. Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyze data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions. Basic Qualifications 3+ years of employee and performance management experience Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays Preferred Qualifications 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information.
